classification.difficultyReason: Directly apply the taught y-axis reflection to each supplied curve, preserving heights and mirroring labelled points; no additional method selection or linked procedure is required.

content.prompt: Sketch the second half of these graphs so they are even.

spec.description: Upper semicircle from (0,0) to (2,0), with dashed guides through (1,1). Empty left half-plane for reflection.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied right half is visible.

answer.short: Reflect the arc in the $y$-axis, adding an upper semicircle from $(-2,0)$ to $(0,0)$ with maximum $(-1,1)$.
answer.worked: Reflection in the $y$-axis sends $(x,y)$ to $(-x,y)$. Add the matching arc through $(-2,0)$, $(-1,1)$ and $(0,0)$.

spec.description: Complete even graph; the added left arc is blue and dashed.
spec.mathematics: Reflection of the supplied upper semicircle in the y-axis.

spec.description: Upper-left branch from the origin through (-1,1), continuing to an arrow. Dashed guides identify (-1,1).
spec.mathematics: Square-root-shaped schematic branch. Only the origin and (-1,1) are numerical givens.

answer.short: Add the reflected upper-right branch through $(1,1)$.
answer.worked: Reflect the supplied branch in the $y$-axis. The origin stays fixed and $(-1,1)$ maps to $(1,1)$; continue the new branch upwards to the right.

spec.description: Supplied left branch and its blue dashed reflection on the right.
Right-hand upward parabola segment through (0,0), minimum (1,-1) and (2,0), with an upward arrow.
spec.mathematics: Supplied branch represented by y=(x-1)^2-1 for x≥0.

answer.short: Add the reflected left branch with minimum $(-1,-1)$ and intercept $(-2,0)$.
answer.worked: Reflect the right branch in the $y$-axis. The minimum $(1,-1)$ maps to $(-1,-1)$ and $(2,0)$ maps to $(-2,0)$. The origin stays fixed.

spec.description: Complete even graph with blue dashed reflected left branch.
Unnumbered axes with a curve rising increasingly steeply from a horizontal tangent at the origin into the first quadrant.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative curve only; no numerical scale or function rule is supplied.

answer.short: Add the matching upward-curving branch to the left of the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: Reflect the supplied curve in the $y$-axis. The origin remains fixed, and the added branch rises to the left with the same shape.

spec.description: Symmetric upward-curving graph with blue dashed added left branch.
spec.mathematics: Exact reflection of the qualitative supplied branch.

spec.description: Left branch with minimum (-1,1), dashed guides, upper-left arrow and a filled endpoint on the positive y-axis.
spec.mathematics: The minimum is (-1,1). The endpoint ordinate is unspecified; its drawing height is schematic and is not labelled.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied left branch and filled endpoint only.

answer.short: Add the reflected right branch with minimum $(1,1)$, meeting the existing filled point on the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: Reflect the left branch in the $y$-axis. The minimum $(-1,1)$ maps to $(1,1)$, while the filled endpoint on the axis stays fixed. Continue the new branch upwards to the right.

spec.description: Complete even graph with reflected minimum (1,1), shared filled point on the y-axis and blue dashed right branch.
spec.mathematics: Reflect the supplied schematic curve without assigning a numerical ordinate to the axis endpoint.

spec.description: Increasing upper-left curve approaches the x-axis towards its left arrow and reaches the y-axis at height 2.

answer.short: Add the reflected right branch, falling from $(0,2)$ and approaching the $x$-axis to the right.
answer.worked: Reflect the supplied curve in the $y$-axis. The point $(0,2)$ stays fixed, and the added branch approaches the $x$-axis as it extends to the right.

spec.description: Complete symmetric curve through (0,2), with blue dashed reflected right branch approaching the x-axis.
